findings.title: Hourly total skips the safe-integer check that daily totals get
findings.why: `dailyTotal` throws 'total is too large' when the price times the days is not a safe integer. `hourlyTotal` does not. An item with a huge `hourlyPrice`, which `validateEquipment` allows up to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, gives an imprecise total for a rental of a few hours. `quote` and `book` then return it as money in cents instead of throwing.

findings.title: Test title does not match what the test does
findings.why: The title says the first cancellation 'was invalid in time'. The test cancels once at a valid instant that gives a full refund, then cancels again and expects 'already cancelled'. Nothing about timing is exercised.
